# SRC-101

> SRC-101 brings namespaces, unique names, renewals, transfers, and records into the Bitcoin Stamps ecosystem.

## Public experience

- Home: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/src-101/
- Discover: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/src-101/reference.html
- Get started: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/src-101/guide.html
- Bitcoin Universe: https://inscribe.bitcoinuniverse.io/

## The experience

- Discover: Explore namespaces and the names that communities build around them.
- Own: Mint an available name and follow its ownership and renewal timeline.
- Connect: Associate supported records and carry the name into new experiences.

## In plain language

- Namespaces: A deployment establishes the space where SRC-101 names can live.
- Names: Each name uses an encoded token identity tied to its namespace.
- Lifecycle: Mint, transfer, renew, and record updates create the name’s timeline.
- Records: Supported signed data can connect a name to useful destinations.

## User safety

Names can be visually similar, renewal timing matters, and record updates affect where a name points. Verify the namespace, exact name, recipient, duration, and signed data before approval.

## Community resources

- Explore Bitcoin Stamps: https://stampchain.io/
- Visit the Stamps FAQ: https://stampchain.io/faq
